# Feature status

Before classifying scope, search `reference.md` section `04` by keyword or
stable ID (`XAL-GNNNNNN`). It is authoritative for implemented, planned, and
excluded status.

Never reuse or renumber IDs. Update status/summary in place; allocate new IDs
at the next free step of 10 in the matching group. Planned work must agree with
sections `05–06`.
